name: cmdstan/php
description: A PHP interface to CmdStan inspired by CmdStanR

suggest.ext-ffi: Required for model methods (log_prob, gradients, constrain/unconstrain) and expose_functions()
suggest.ext-php_stats: Required for loo(moment_match: true): provides the stats_draw_moments, stats_draw_covariance_map, and stats_draw_affine kernels; StanData::fromFormula() also needs its stats_model_matrix()
suggest.erikwestlund/phibble: Data frames: pass a Phibble\Frame as model data, and get draws and summaries back with to_frame() and summary_frame() (PHP 8.5)
